An AI agent that automates a daily research workflow.

Every day the agent:

1. Searches arXiv for topics you care about.
2. Filters out papers it has shown you before.
3. Summarizes each new paper in 2–3 bullets.
4. Writes a Markdown digest file.

You talk to the agent in plain English; it decides which tools to call.

**Design choices**

- arXiv API over scraping
- SQLite for seen-paper memory (lookup, not vectors)
- Groq with tool calling (`qwen/qwen3-8b`-class models)
- Run-scoped store, streaming summarizer, rate limiting from day one

Phase 1 (agent core) is complete. Later phases: evals, cost tracking, reliability, and deploy.

**Stack:** Python, Groq, SQLite, uv.

Source: [Utkarsh736/workflow-agent](https://github.com/Utkarsh736/workflow-agent).
